title: A retired leg with an open position keeps its telemetry writer until the position closes (due 2026-11-05)
note: Manager decision (d) on GLD-ORPHAN-5209, 2026-11-01. DUE 2026-11-05. position_telemetry is written only from each strategy unit's own open-position management (record_position_telemetry calls in src/units/strategies/*), which does not run once a leg is enabled: false. So a retired leg's open position gets no telemetry, live_review_due reads it telemetry_absent, and it can never be reviewed (measured: gld_pullback_1h trade 5209, the only open trade of 12 on a disabled strategy, 2026-11-01). Not folded into PR #22215 because the fix lives in the strategy loop / monitor dispatch, not the reconciler. Build: the monitor keeps running the telemetry write (read-only path) for every open package whose strategy is disabled, until the package closes, with a test; off the trade path is not off the data path. Re-entry test: live_review_due shows such a package with telemetry_state present.
